title: Development Layout Migration and Equipment Slot Foundation
changes: Reproduced the Windows Build all stop after successful LPC indexing, character-cache generation, and ElizaWy object-atlas generation: validate_development_layout rejected the root SCRIPTS tree and four active stale references.
Moved active pass validators into domain-specific tools/automation/validation/checks folders and removed retired root-path references from both validator registries and the tool registry.
Updated the shared validation runner to load the canonical tools/automation/validation package only.

Extended workspace normalization to migrate any existing SCRIPTS/validation framework files before validation, route known pass validators canonically, preserve unknown scripts under tools/archive, and remove the retired root tree.
Added equivalent PowerShell build preflight so Bash and PowerShell builds normalize the workspace before any validation or compilation step.

Added the complete LPC equipment data authority with 19 standard equipment slots, one conditional mobility slot, multi-slot occupancy rules, renderer anchors, appearance separation, hotbar/tool hand occupancy, and pregnancy-as-body-state policy.
Added Equipment, Wardrobe, Appearance, and Loadouts menu contracts while explicitly leaving final graphical runtime screen wiring as follow-on work.
Added focused synthetic migration and equipment-contract validation and updated cumulative documentation through Pass 167Z43.
